scripts.lint: turbo run lint --filter='./packages/*' && test -n "$(git ls-files -- ':!packages' '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.js' '*.jsx' '*.mjs' '*.cjs')" && git ls-files -z -- ':!packages' '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.js' '*.jsx' '*.mjs' '*.cjs' | xargs -0 node packages/tui/scripts/gate-scope.mjs lint biome lint --reporter=json --
scripts.format:check: test -n "$(git ls-files)" && git ls-files -z | xargs -0 biome format --files-ignore-unknown=true -- && printf 'format: %s tracked files handed to biome (unknown types skipped)\n' "$(git ls-files | wc -l)"
scripts.validate:naming: ls-lint && printf 'naming: %s source files checked against .ls-lint.yml (kebab-case)\n' "$(git ls-files -- packages | grep -cE '^packages/[^/]+/(src|tests)/.*\.(ts|tsx)$')"
scripts.gates: pnpm format:check && pnpm validate:naming && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm depcruise && pnpm build && pnpm test
